g.text: FRANK LLOYD WRIGHT (1950) · T. HEINZ AIA
RL-04: SOLID BATTERED BUFF PARAPET (GLASS RAIL DELETED)
RL-05: NW RUBBLESTONE WALL, WHALE ROCK CLIFF & 3 PIERS
RL-06: EAST WING STONE CHIMNEY & BUFF PARAPET
▲ REDLINE RL-04..06 · REV P03.1 AS-BUILT FIELD VERIFICATION
STRIKE-THROUGH: Deleted unauthentic Railing_SW_Glass_1..4 & Railing_SW_Cap_1..4 around SW Prow Balcony.
AS-BUILT FIX: Installed continuous Mitered Battered Buff-Stucco Parapet (EL +2.86m to +4.75m) & Hexagonal Lake Pier.
NW FACADE FIX: Added Full-Height Mid-NW Desert-Rubblestone Wall, 14-Bay Mahogany Ribbon Windows & 3 Whale-Rock Piers.
